requirements: R1: Extend the existing generic materials entity and endpoints to validate and store protocol-specific attributes (e.g., procedural steps, approvals).
R2: Extend the existing generic materials entity and endpoints to validate and store raw data-specific structures (e.g., sample metrics, collection parameters).

slices.title: Patch generic materials entity to support protocol and data attributes
slices.jtbd: When implementing attribute support for this epic, I want to extend the generic materials code, so that protocols and data retain their specific structures without needing a new data model.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user adds a protocol, When submitted, Then the system validates and stores procedural steps in existing structures.
Given a user uploads data, When submitted, Then the system validates and stores sample metrics in existing structures.
Given the patched code is tested, When unit and integration tests run, Then they verify the generic materials entity correctly handles protocol and data specific attributes.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce missing protocol/data attribute errors to 0

requirements: R1: Track previous versions and maintain a revision history when an epidemiological protocol or material description is updated.
R2: Expose the revision history to allow users to view who changed what and when, and retrieve the content of past versions.

slices.title: Patch materials code to track and retrieve revisions
slices.jtbd: When implementing versioning for this epic, I want to patch the existing materials code to save past revisions, so that the revision history can be audited.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a material is edited, When saved, Then the system tracks the previous version and maintains revision history.
Given a user views the material history, When requested, Then the system returns the list of historical revisions and their content.
Given the patched code is tested, When unit and integration tests run, Then they verify the material history is correctly tracked and retrieved.

epics.title: System Runtime Stabilization
epics.jtbd: When the product is deployed, I want the system to launch successfully and pass its health check, so that users can access the system and we can gather real evidence.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase runtime health check pass rate to 100%
requirements: R1: Fix the underlying issue causing the launch failure or health check failure to restore healthy runtime observation.

slices.title: Fix runtime health check failure
slices.jtbd: When implementing the runtime fix for this epic, I want to patch the startup or health check configuration, so that the system launches successfully and passes health checks.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the system is launched, When the startup sequence executes, Then the application starts without crashing.
Given the application is running, When the health check is polled, Then it returns a healthy status.
Given the patched runtime configuration is tested, When E2E tests run, Then they pass successfully.
